full_judgment: 2. Facts relevant for disposal of the rule are that the petitioners herein as plaintiffs instituted Other Suit No.97 of 2000 in the 5th Court of learned Assistant Judge, Sadar, Chittagong, for declaration of title contending inter alia that the suit land belonged to Rahmathullah, Nazir Ahmed, Abdus Sobhan and Alef Khan Sukani; Rahmathullah sold his share to one Abdul Hamid whose name has been recorded in the remark column of R.S. khatian; After expiry of Abdul Hamid his heirs transferred the land to one Haji Ibrahim vide registered kabala dated 20.01.1943; Haji Ibrahid died leaving wife Jarina, son Abu Syed and daughter Salma Khatoon; Said Jarina and Salma Khatoon sold their share measuring .33 decimals of land to one Abdun Nur Sawdagor vide registered kabala dated 21.05.1962; Abu Syed sold 4 gondas of land to one Md. Hossain vide registered kabala dated 20.04.1962 who in his turn sold the same to Abdun Nur Sawdagar vide registered kabala dated 21.07.1962; Abdun Nur Sawdagar died leaving the plaintiffs as his heirs. Defendants claimed title in the suit land and lodged a GD with Chandgaon police station; After investigation it was found that the defendants claim is false; On 01.07.2000, defendants tried to dispossess the plaintiffs from suit land on the plea that B.S. khatian stands in their names; It was alleged that the suit property was partitioned on the basis of a Wasiatnama but subsequently said wasiatnama had been cancelled by the parties amicably; Thereafter, heirs of Hazi Ibrahim executed and registered an agreement (Nadabinama) on 25.09.1963 in favour of the heirs of Abdun Nur Sawdagar admitting title and possession of the plaintiffs in the suit land; But the defendants again claiming the suit land on the basis of wrong B.S. record. Hence, the suit.
